title: Competency-based resource allocation
summary: A conceptual approach for examining existing competencies, task requirements and organisational needs.

text: The model addresses the question of how existing staff resources can be deployed more sensibly and existing competencies used better.
Which competencies are available – which competencies are needed – and how can the two be brought together more effectively?

modell.note: Possible options: transfer, further development, change of tasks, new forms of cooperation, new hiring, another organisational solution.

text: An organisation needs additional capacity in a particular area of work. At the same time, there are employees internally with suitable core competencies who currently mainly carry out other tasks.
It can then first be examined whether an internal change would make economic and organisational sense.
Decisions about resources are considered not only in terms of headcount and costs, but also in terms of competencies, needs and impact.
The model is a business and organisational review and not employment law advice.
